rows.title: Authoritative ISO export / version stamp for DownloadStateData
rows.evidence: Phase 17 live DownloadStateData sha256 unchanged vs Phase 10–16 baseline; filename MMDDYYYY still 11152026 → ISO candidate 2026-11-15 (rejected); FAQ still "updated weekly" (policy-only); no Last-Modified/ETag; mailbox check for CDSS reply unavailable in this environment — clarification remains sent-awaiting-response.
rows.riskIfIgnored: Published roster could not cite a source-issued as-of date; freshness claims would be non-authoritative.
rows.requiredRemediation: Obtain CDSS-confirmed authoritative ISO export date or equivalent source-issued version channel; do not resend clarification; do not substitute filename/download/weekly cadence.

rows.title: Roster-wide FacilityDetail status verification
rows.evidence: Phase 16 status sample N=36 only (27 match / 6 documented-coarsening / 2 conflict / 1 invalid-id). Roster-wide FacilityDetail complete=false. Sampled ON PROBATION↔Probationary License conflicts kept unknown-ineligible without invented equivalence.
rows.riskIfIgnored: Undetected Download↔FacilityDetail conflicts could publish ineligible or mislabeled facilities.
rows.requiredRemediation: Complete rate-limited roster FacilityDetail status verification under separate human approval, or adopt an explicit human-approved policy that unverified candidates remain excluded until verified.

rows.title: Official disclosure-link coverage not roster-complete
rows.evidence: Cumulative verified disclosure links 462 / 15,451 (~2.99%). Phase 16 incremental 115 all working. statewideCoverageClaimed=false. Additional ~100-facility samples add <1pp coverage and do not change launch readiness.
rows.riskIfIgnored: Cannot claim every published facility has a verified official disclosure URL.
rows.requiredRemediation: Pause small incremental samples. When separately approved, run rate-limited full-roster disclosure verification via Phase 13 harness; until then keep unverified candidates unpublished/unclaimable.

rows.title: CDSS clarification response for export-date channel
rows.evidence: Clarification already sent in prior phase. Phase 17: no authorized connected mailbox available to inspect inbox; duplicate inquiry forbidden. Official docs re-probed — still no ISO export stamp.
rows.riskIfIgnored: Freshness gate remains blocked indefinitely without an authoritative channel or human policy change.
rows.requiredRemediation: Human checks authorized mailbox / CDSS reply; if reply arrives, capture evidence and evaluate channel; never resend duplicate inquiry from agents.

rows.title: Unique valid facility identifiers with fail-closed invalid IDs
rows.evidence: 8–9 digit IDs with leading zeros preserved. Invalid 95354 refuse-closed. Truncated 15601219 non-canonical vs exact 015601219. Safeguards pass; roster publication still requires fail-closed ID policy statewide.
rows.riskIfIgnored: Malformed or truncated IDs could generate wrong disclosure URLs or duplicate identities.
rows.requiredRemediation: Keep fail-closed ID rules; exclude invalid/ambiguous IDs from any future candidate set.

rows.title: Capacity field integrity (no invented capacities)
rows.evidence: Baseline: 21 official blanks on PENDING excluded rows only; 0 publication-candidate blanks; invented capacities=0.
rows.riskIfIgnored: Inventing capacities would falsify official roster fields.
rows.requiredRemediation: Preserve official blanks; never invent. Candidate capacity integrity currently passes (0 blanks).

rows.title: 28 unresolved official coordinates
rows.evidence: 15,423 verified official coords / 28 unresolved / 0 fabricated. Phase 16–17 do not re-probe without new authoritative evidence.
rows.riskIfIgnored: Map pins for 28 facilities would be missing or fabricated if forced.
rows.requiredRemediation: Exclude the 28 unresolved facilities from map publication until authoritative coords exist; do not geocode/fabricate; do not repeat unsuccessful probes.

rows.title: 14 statewide LICENSED + empty License First Date rows
rows.riskIfIgnored: Publishing LICENSED rows without initial dates risks never-licensed / mislabeled eligibility.
rows.requiredRemediation: Keep unknown-ineligible / unpublishable / unclaimable until authoritative dates exist; exclude from candidate set. FAQ "No date on file" does not authorize publication.

rows.title: Sampled status conflicts (e.g. ON PROBATION vs Probationary License)
rows.evidence: Phase 16 sampled conflicts include 342700333, 496803751, 335530163, 496802077, 342701152, 515002949, 486804268 kept unknown-ineligible. Not a statewide equivalence mapping.
rows.riskIfIgnored: Invented status equivalence could misclassify restricted/probationary facilities as fully licensed.
rows.requiredRemediation: Exclude conflicting facilities; do not invent Closed*/Probation equivalence; optional CDSS status-label clarification is separate from export-date inquiry (do not duplicate export-date email).

rows.title: Individual conflict facility 502701867
rows.evidence: Download LICENSED vs FacilityDetail Pending Incomplete Application; empty license dates; unknown-ineligible / unpublishable / unclaimable.
rows.riskIfIgnored: Could publish a never-licensed / pending application as licensed.

rows.title: Invalid ID 95354 + withdrawn Application Withdrawn controls
rows.evidence: 95354 refuse-closed; five CLOSED→Application Withdrawn regression controls withdrawn-ineligible; leading zeros preserved.
rows.riskIfIgnored: Weakening would allow invalid IDs or withdrawn applications into publication.

rows.title: Eligible RCFE/ARF types + exclusive-bucket accounting 24,377
rows.evidence: Exclusive buckets 15,413 active + 38 restricted + 8,921 excluded + 5 exceptions = 24,377. Download sha256 unchanged in Phase 17 live probe.
rows.riskIfIgnored: Accounting drift would invalidate roster denominators used for readiness claims.
rows.requiredRemediation: Preserve exclusive-bucket invariant; re-validate on any source-data change.

rows.title: Publication and owner-claim safeguards remain closed
rows.evidence: californiaDirectoryReady()=false; californiaPhase17AllowsPublication()=false; gate blocked; California unpublished; owner claims ineligible.
rows.riskIfIgnored: Opening safeguards early would publish incomplete California data.
rows.requiredRemediation: Do not change or open the publication gate until human-approved stop/go conditions are all met.

rows.title: Future CCLD Public Portal / FMS channels
rows.evidence: Modernization docs describe future portals; not usable today as DownloadStateData export date.
rows.requiredRemediation: Watch only; do not treat as current freshness evidence.
